# Webhook collections

The API endpoint in this section allows you to get a list of webhooks of a specific Actor.

<!-- -->

## [Get list of webhooks](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-webhooks-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/webhooks](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-webhooks-get.md)
